about.about_page_title: Yame connects mill capacity, packaging detail and export execution for professional buyers.
about.about_page_desc: We focus on parent rolls and finished tissue products, including toilet tissue, kitchen towels, napkins, paper towels, facial tissue and pocket tissue.
about.about_page_content: For more than 18 years, we have worked with China and Vietnam mills to support retail, away-from-home and foodservice channels. Our work is less about one-off selling and more about keeping specifications, samples, packaging and shipment details aligned for repeat orders.
about.mission_desc: We work with established China and Vietnam mills to balance quality, price and supply continuity across recurring tissue programs.
about.vision_desc: Our product scope stays focused on tissue categories that global retail, hospitality and foodservice buyers source repeatedly.
about.approach_desc: We keep specifications, sampling, packaging review, QC photos and export documents organized so repeat orders stay predictable.
